description: Slots: a panel for each of Baude's things that fit, laid out in the node's space.

where.description: Only those whose fields are these (a chat's host, state, bot).

sort.description: Their order: the last used first, or by name.

layout.description: row: side by side along x; grid: rows of columns; ring: round the node's y axis, facing out of it; stack: each above the last.

spacing.description: Metres between them (a ring's radius for ring).

panel.description: How each is drawn (its show, px and size): left out for none. It's a node of the slot's, <slots>/<n>/panel.

hidden.description: Whether each slot's panel starts hidden (a reveal, or the theme's code, shows it).

with.description: Nodes put in each slot's space beside its panel (a box it's in, a stand), for its thing: their ids are the slot's and theirs (<slots>/<n>/<id>), their parent the slot unless they name another of these.
